channel.title: Gray-Zone & Critical Infrastructure Risk Monitor
channel.description: Executive Briefing & Keyless Federal/Backbone OSINT Telemetry (CISA, FAA NAS, Federal Register, Cloud Status)

item.title: [Tracked #1] Microsoft 365 (Global Cloud, Enterprise & Healthcare)
item.description: Nov. 12–13, 2026 (~18–24+ hrs) — Impact: Disrupted Outlook, Teams, SharePoint & Copilot across 70+ countries; hospital "Code Grey" alerts & clinical workarounds; ~USD 7B est. global loss (DistilINFO; IVN) | Vector: Dormant July 2026 gateway lock-contention bug + Teams failover + 14% maintenance outage + ~10-hr "thundering herd" stall; degraded Defender XDR & Purview (GeekWire) | Status: Restored; final PIR due Nov. 20, 2026.

item.title: [Tracked #2] FAA / L3Harris FTI Backbone (National Aviation / ATC)
item.description: Nov. 13, 2026 (3:54–8:15 p.m. ET) — Impact: 4.5-hr nationwide ground stop; ~12,462 flight disruptions; 17 of 22 ARTCCs destabilized; ~USD 345M Big-Four airline earnings hit | Vector: Two-router broadcast flood (El Dorado, AR Friday 3:30 p.m. ET cutover + 3-wk-old Amarillo, TX Juniper router on legacy TDM); HPE cites installer config (WTTW / AP) | Status: Nov. 17: FAA halted router rollout & powered off all ~400 installed Juniper routers; Florida FBI/lab probe active. WaPo reports on-site FAA official tested & signed off on El Dorado cutover 8 mins before ground stop; White House formed multi-agency "tiger team."

item.title: [Tracked #3] Workday (WD1 Enterprise HR, Payroll & Finance Cloud)
item.description: Nov. 13–14, 2026 — Impact: Multi-hour production lockdown across enterprise & university WD1 tenants disrupting logins, timekeeping, accounting & APIs (FAU OIT) | Vector: DR test unexpectedly connected to live production DBs, causing inconsistent production data; non-cyber (Logistics Viewpoints) | Status: Restored Nov. 14; manual enterprise payroll/HR/API data reconciliation ongoing.

item.title: [Tracked #4] Optimizely, Kissmetrics, StorifyMe & minute-ly (Web Supply Chain — 178 Orgs)
item.description: Nov. 13–17, 2026 (OPTIMJACK) — Impact: Infected 188 JS snippets across Zoom, HSBC, Equifax, Salesforce, BBC, CNN, Fox News, Peacock, GitLab & Optimizely login; clippers, skimmers & .icu iOS exploit routing (StepSecurity) | Vector: Confirmed Malicious Attack via Optimizely account signup flow; 26 payload mutations (Report URI); active 16–19 hrs via projectJS (affecting custom CNAMEs too), seeded from webshell[.]lol (04:21 UTC Nov. 16); remediated by Optimizely (Black Kite) | Status: 1688360[.]cc placed on hold Nov. 17; wallets swept toward HitBTC; manual audit of Project JS required for atob()/inline fallbacks.

item.title: [Tracked #5] JPMorgan Chase & Zelle Rails (Tier-1 Banking / G-SIB)
item.description: Nov. 16, 2026 (Morning – Evening) — Impact: ~4,800+ Chase outage reports; branch teller & ATM disruptions; counterparty Zelle/transfer delays across BofA, Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, Capital One & Truist (AP News) | Vector: Software bug in on-premise hardware systems + queued peak traffic re-crashes; non-cyber (TIME) | Status: Restored Monday night; Tuesday ACH/Zelle cleared cleanly; JPM closed -2.3% Monday.

item.title: [Tracked #6] United Airlines (Commercial Aviation)
item.description: Nov. 16, 2026 (~1:30–4:30 p.m. CST) — Impact: Mainline departures held nationwide (418 flights delayed); airborne & United Express unaffected (CBS News) | Vector: Widespread system outage in pre-departure weight-and-balance dispatch system; cyber ruled out (The Guardian) | Status: Resolved Monday evening after ~1 hr 40 min; operations normal Tuesday.

item.title: [Tracked #7] Marriott International (Global Hospitality — 10,200+ Properties)
item.description: Nov. 17, 2026 (~8:17 a.m. CST onward) — Impact: Sign-in, online booking, Bonvoy app, and property check-in disruptions (AP News; Gulf News) | Vector: Technical issue affecting sign-in capabilities; cyber ruled out by Marriott | Status: Resolved Tuesday evening alongside technology partners.

item.title: [Tracked #8] National Security Agency — NSANet (Classified Intelligence Enclave)
item.description: Nov. 17, 2026 (Morning – Afternoon) — Impact: Internal classified network degraded/offline; Fort Meade ordered "Code Gray"/"Code Yellow" staggered arrivals to prevent login storms; Five Eyes unaffected (CBS News) | Vector: Scheduled routine maintenance/patching after weeks of instability; White House/NSA rule out cyberattack (Fox News) | Status: Official NSA statement cites routine maintenance degradation; full internal restoration timing unconfirmed entering Nov. 18 House hearing.

item.title: [Tracked #9] Charles Schwab & Enterprise SaaS (Lever) (Brokerage & Cloud SaaS)
item.description: Nov. 17, 2026 (Morning – Midday) — Impact: Client web login failures at Schwab (trading & mobile unaffected); ~3-hr backend 504 outage at Lever (Fox News; IsDown) | Vector: Schwab cited "brief webpage loading issue"; SaaS backend gateway timeouts | Status: Resolved Tuesday; tracking heightened Downdetector sensitivity vs. shared CDN strain.

item.title: [Tracked #10] Apple Ecosystem & iOS/Gmail Cascade (Consumer, Payments & Enterprise)
item.description: Nov. 17, 2026 (~11:33 a.m. CST onward) — Impact: Outages across App Store/Connect, iCloud Sign-In (>1,800 reports), Apple Pay (>2,300), Apple Music, AppleCare & Business/School Manager; caused downstream iOS Gmail login errors (Tom's Guide; 9to5Mac) | Vector: Apple confirmed an "internal update caused some outages this morning"; Google confirmed Workspace/Gmail remained 100% healthy | Status: All Apple services (including iCloud Sign-In & Apple Pay) confirmed fully restored by 5:59 p.m. ET Nov. 17.
